LanguageData.Gun_TF_CompMRL.label: Experimental composite magnetic rail launcher
LanguageData.Gun_TF_CompMRL.description: A composite multi-purpose weapon consisting of recycled mechanoid magnetic rails combined with modified assault rifle, with two firing modes. In the burst firing state, the use of orbital increment powder powered bullets greatly enhances the muzzle velocity and increases the bullet's penetration power. In the launcher mode, small-sized LGIS missiles can be cold-fired using the magnetic rail, increasing the firing speed, but after three shots, the weapon will be damaged.
